🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; confirmations: narrow leadership among Tech winners and widespread divergence between 1W and 1M across major names.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare is second: PFE (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.38%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Energy and Communication show weakness with negative 1W returns; Communication example: CHTR (1W: -12.93% | 1M: -21.79%) BELOW TREND, Energy example: XOM (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -1.16%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentration is a caution flag.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: GD (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -12.37%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -7.27% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, FDX (1W: -7.35% | 1M: -15.99%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -9.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Consumer Disc.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +13.62% | 1M: -1.21%) RECOVERY — note major divergence (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M), so tactical not broad.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows concentrated leadership but mixed internals: NVDA (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND — sector positive on 1W headline but internals uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on the week: JPM (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -5.08%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -5.63%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND — breadth shows Financials lagging, no convincing cyclical rotation into banks.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is one of two positive sectors with mixed signals: PFE (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.38%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +3.87% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY — select defensive names showing short-term strength amid news flow.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective Tech winners and isolated Industrials showing confirmed 1M follow-through (e.g., ETN (1W: +10.61% | 1M: +7.67%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to large-cap laggards exhibiting confirmed BELOW TREND behavior (ORCL, INTU, CHTR). Monitor liquidity and concentration risk given narrow leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -25.08%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -8.11% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (headline winners driving most upside) and Healthcare (select defensive recovery). BEARISH: Financials and Utilities — both showing weak 1W internals and negative breadth.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above this week’s breakout; watch AAPL (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION for whether 1W weakness extends; watch ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND for further distribution.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+55): Lam higher outlook; LRCX (1W: +14.18% | 1M: -2.28%) RECOVERY — news aligns with short-term rally. TSLA (+60): Semi production ramp; TSLA (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-50): Data-center build issues; ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND — news confirms downside. CCI (-60): Dividend cut concerns; CCI (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +17.09% | 1M: +45.62%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +15.44% | 1M: +31.32%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +14.05% | 1M: +36.51%) ABOVE TREND are current relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech leadership, breadth only 2/11 and major 1W vs 1M divergences (monitor ORCL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -3.61%) BELOW TREND and persistent sentiment mismatches).
